sections.heading: What Is RCS Business Messaging and How Does It Work?

blocks.html: RCS, or Rich Communication Services, is the messaging standard built by the GSM Association to replace plain SMS with a richer, branded experience. Unlike a chatbot app a customer has to download separately, an RCS business messaging platform runs natively inside Google Messages — the default inbox already installed on most Android phones in India. A customer never leaves their messaging app, and a business never asks anyone to install anything new.

items.title: Runs over data or Wi-Fi:
items.desc: Messages travel through the default messaging app's own connection, not the older SMS gateway.

items.title: No app to download:
items.desc: Conversations happen in the inbox a customer already opens every day.

items.title: Falls back automatically:
items.desc: Devices that don't support RCS yet receive the message as standard SMS instead, so nothing gets dropped.

items.title: Built on an open standard:
items.desc: The GSMA's Universal Profile means the same rich message renders consistently across carriers, not just on one network.

blocks.html: The GSMA maintains the full Rich Communication Services standard if you want to go deeper on how the protocol itself works.

sections.heading: Understanding RCS Messaging Pricing in India

blocks.html: RCS pricing usually has two parts. Your provider charges a platform fee for the campaign builder, dashboard and analytics. Message delivery is billed separately, by message type, with standard SMS rates applying only when a device falls back because it doesn't support RCS yet. Add 18% GST, billed in INR, and that's the full picture.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions: RCS Messaging Provider in Bangalore

items.q: What should I check before choosing an RCS messaging provider in Bangalore?
items.a: Check for Google-verified sender status, a plain INR rate card instead of a "contact sales" placeholder, real message-level analytics, and support based in your own time zone. Ojiva AI provides all four, plus hands-on help with Google's brand verification process.

items.q: How much does RCS messaging cost in India?
items.a: There's a platform subscription for the dashboard and analytics, plus per-message delivery charges, with fallback SMS billed separately for unsupported devices. 18% GST applies. Book a demo for an exact rate card based on your message volume.

items.q: RCS messaging vs WhatsApp Business API — which should I use?
items.a: They're complementary rather than competing. RCS reaches any Android device with the default Messages app and no separate opt-in required, while WhatsApp needs the customer to already have the app installed. Most businesses run both from one dashboard with automatic fallback between them.

items.q: How does RCS messaging work for businesses?
items.a: A business registers as a verified RCS agent and sends rich, interactive messages through the RCS Business Messaging API. The message appears natively inside the customer's default messaging app, with no download required, and falls back to standard SMS automatically on unsupported devices.

items.q: Is RCS messaging secure enough for OTP delivery?
items.a: Yes. Messages are encrypted between your system, Google's servers and the customer's device, and the verified sender badge makes it harder for a spoofed message to be mistaken for a real one — a meaningful improvement over an unbranded SMS OTP.

items.q: What are the quick-reply and carousel features in RCS messaging?
items.a: Quick replies are one-tap buttons for common responses like "Yes," "Track order" or "Add to calendar." Carousels let customers swipe through multiple products or options inside the same message, without opening a separate app or webpage.

items.q: How do I switch from SMS to RCS messaging?
items.a: Your existing number and templates carry over — RCS runs on top of the same messaging infrastructure, with SMS as an automatic fallback for devices that don't support it yet. Most businesses migrate templates gradually rather than switching everything at once.

items.q: Which industries in Bangalore benefit most from RCS messaging?
items.a: E-commerce, banking, real estate and healthcare see the clearest gains, since each relies on visual confirmation — product images, transaction alerts, property photos or appointment reminders — that plain SMS can't display. Any business already using SMS for updates can extend the same message into RCS.
